boards.readiness: Whether the product is good enough for its named target.
boards.actualization: Whether this deployment has made the capability real.

contract.title: Contract
contract.means: The promise, the forbidden behavior, and the pass rule are written.

correct.title: Correct
correct.means: The result matches the host or the declared specification.

safe.title: Safe
safe.means: No unauthorized write, leak, invented fact, or broken separation of duties.

continuous.title: Continuous
continuous.means: Repeated runs and the next turn stay true. One pass does not count.

fast.title: Fast
fast.means: The declared latency budget holds on the relevant population.

proven.title: Proven
proven.means: The required evidence is current. A stale or partial run stays visible.

built.title: Built
built.means: The behavior exists in the version this instance runs.

configured.title: Configured
configured.means: Policies, periods, workflows, and local rules are set.

data.title: Data
data.means: Required records are complete, valid, accurate, current, and reconciled.

access.title: Access
access.means: The real roles, scope, and separation of duties are in place.

adopted.title: Adopted
adopted.means: The named persona completes the scenario without a shadow process.

operated.title: Operated
operated.means: Support, monitoring, recovery, and the runbook are ready.

live.title: Live
live.means: A valid real cycle exists. A demo or seed does not close this cell.

memory.title: Memory
memory.question: Does confirmed memory stay scoped and usable?

expertise.title: Expertise
expertise.question: Does it stay correct across the declared scenario families?

operations.title: Operations
operations.question: Does the service hold over time?

payroll.title: Payroll
payroll.question: Can a month of pay be legally relied on?

finance-b.title: Finance B
finance-b.question: Is a finance system of record in scope and proven?

documents.title: Documents
documents.question: Are business records governed and linked?

pulse.title: Pulse
pulse.question: Can someone depend on Ask and Plan?

nibras.title: Nibras
nibras.question: What is enterprise-grade, and what is real at GOFSCO?

cell.unmeasuredReading: No probe is bound to this cell.
cell.neighbor: This page does not borrow a neighboring cell. Lab proof stays on the lab row. Staff go-live stays on the staff target.

target.title: Target profile
target.body: A named definition of done. Staff go-live, legal payroll, Ask dependable, and Plan enterprise are different targets and can be true at the same time.

leaf.title: Atomic leaf
leaf.body: One scenario, one persona, one site, one channel, and one material variant. Features support the leaf. They are not a second percentage.

readiness.title: Readiness
readiness.body: Product quality against the named target. It does not say the customer has entered the data.

actualization.title: Actualization
actualization.body: Instance reality: built, configured, populated, authorized, adopted, operated, and used for real.

weakest.title: Weakest gate
weakest.body: A row is only as ready as its weakest required cell. A percentage cannot hide one critical failure.

unknown.title: Unmeasured
unknown.body: No probe is bound. The cell stays on the board. It is not zero and it is not green.

partial-run.title: Partial rerun
partial-run.body: A rerun updates only the cells it exercised. The last full run remains the row baseline.

evidence.title: Evidence facets
evidence.body: Every measured cell names its proof. Dev evidence cannot upgrade production. Seed data cannot close a live gate.

owners.title: Two owners
owners.body: The accountable owner accepts the gap. The resolver supplies the data, configuration, or proof. A missing owner is itself a gap.

sources.title: Source register
sources.body: ADR-0046, ADR-0051, the Pulse benches, NSR-9, the deployment certificate, and the Nibras strategy. This room is generated from those sources.
